clue.text: By which to remember a flower-girl?

parts.note: a rose is a familiar garden flower
Mary is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A riddle asking what helps you recall a girl who sells flowers.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition leans on Ophelia's line in Hamlet: the herb is 'for remembrance'. 'flower-girl' looks like one thing, a seller of flowers, but splits into a flower and a girl's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's Ophelia hands out the herb as the emblem of remembrance, so it is the plant by which one remembers.

clue.text: Cleveland's revolutionary form of transport

definitions.note: a possessive: the seaside town belonging to the former county of Cleveland

parts.note: red stands for a revolutionary or communist
a car is a form of transport

explanation.surface: A northern county's radical new vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: Cleveland was an English county in north-east England (1974-96), home to the seaside town.
explanation.definitionFit: The resort town on the North Sea coast lay within Cleveland, so it is one of that county's places.

clue.text: Ally left at sea in glorious surroundings

indicators.note: surroundings means the word for glorious goes round the nautical word for left

parts.note: super means excellent or glorious
port is the nautical term for the left-hand side

explanation.surface: A friend stranded out at sea in splendid scenery.
explanation.definitionFit: A backer or adherent is on one's side, as an ally is.

clue.text: Berthing-place from the time of Othello

parts.note: Othello is Shakespeare's Moor of Venice
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A dock dating back to Shakespeare's tragic general's day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the time of Othello' reads as a period in history but gives the Moor's age.
explanation.definitionFit: A place where a boat is tied up or anchored is a berth.

clue.text: Inclined to make money

explanation.surface: Disposed to earn a living.
explanation.definitionFit: Willing describes a person disposed to act, and 'ready money' is cash at hand, shortened to the noun.

clue.text: State base for the inexperienced

parts.note: Cal is an abbreviation for the US state of California
base in the sense of low, mean or ignoble

explanation.surface: A government provides a foundation for raw beginners.
explanation.definitionFit: Callow describes youth lacking experience of life, like an unfledged bird.

clue.text: Self-disciplined as many before call-up

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, i.e. many

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word for call is written upwards, backwards

parts.note: cite means call, as to summon to court

explanation.surface: Austere, as many conscripts are before their military service begins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'call-up' suggests conscription; it is CITE written upwards, giving ETIC.
explanation.definitionFit: A person practising severe self-denial for religious or moral reasons shows strict self-discipline.

clue.text: What some call or name this heroine

indicators.note: some means part of the words that follow, so the letters lie inside call or name

explanation.surface: A heroine whose name people might shout or recite.
explanation.walkthrough: The heroine is Lorna Doone of R. D. Blackmore's Exmoor romance.
explanation.definitionFit: Blackmore's novel is named after its title character, the leading female figure.

clue.text: Ely's a new resort for a chapelgoer

indicators.note: resort read as re-sort means to sort again, a rearrangement

parts.note: the letters of Ely's, with its S

explanation.surface: The cathedral city of Ely is a fresh holiday spot for a Methodist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resort' looks like a seaside town but means re-sort. Ely is an English cathedral city.
explanation.definitionFit: A follower of John Wesley is a Methodist, who worships in a chapel.

clue.text: Stop assistance raised members of two generations

indicators.note: in a down clue raised means the word for assistance is written upwards

parts.note: aid means assistance
a father and his son are of successive generations
a father and his son are of successive generations

explanation.surface: Halt the help given to parents and children.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns AID to DIA. 'Stop' is the noun: an organ stop.
explanation.definitionFit: On an organ, the principal foundation register is one of the stops controlling the pipes.

clue.text: Foreign body that may demand civil defence heads on a plate

definitions.text: Foreign body that may demand civil defence heads on a plate

parts.words: Foreign body that may demand civil defence heads on a plate
parts.note: the foreign envoys stationed in a capital have the letters CD (the heads of civil defence, also the initials of their French title) on their car number plates; 'demand heads on a plate' plays on Salome's request

explanation.surface: Some alien organisation calls for the decapitation of the civil defence leaders.
explanation.walkthrough: CD stood both for Civil Defence, a British wartime volunteer service, and for Corps Diplomatique, shown on diplomats' number plates. 'heads on a plate' suggests a gruesome demand but means initials on a car plate.
explanation.definitionFit: The body of ambassadors and envoys from other countries resident in a capital is a foreign body in a literal sense.

clue.text: Irregularity? Only a contrived cover for mother

indicators.note: the rearranged letters act as a cover wrapped round the word for mother
contrived means made up or artificially arranged, so the words only a are to be rearranged

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother

explanation.surface: Something odd: just a cooked-up excuse to protect one's mum.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contrived' makes ANOLY from ONLY A, and 'cover for' puts MA inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: An anomaly is something that deviates from the normal rule, an oddity.

clue.text: Old dish returning, say, as number one

indicators.note: returning means coming back, so the letters built from the following words are read backwards

parts.note: eg (for example) is what 'say' means when introducing an instance
being number one is being at top

explanation.surface: A traditional dish coming back into favour as the top choice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns the whole of EG + AT TOP, giving the letters backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Pottage is an old-fashioned thick soup or stew, as in Esau's mess of it.

clue.text: Exorbitant, the Parisian church overheads

parts.note: steep, of a price, means excessive
les is French for 'the' (plural), as a Parisian would say it

explanation.surface: Overpriced French church roofs.
explanation.definitionFit: Spires rise above churches, so they are the buildings' overhead parts.

clue.text: Painter and sculptor, student and prophet

parts.note: L is a learner, as on British L-plates
a seer foresees the future

explanation.surface: An artist, a learner and a visionary all in one.
explanation.walkthrough: Sir Edwin Landseer painted animals and sculpted the lions in Trafalgar Square.
explanation.definitionFit: The Victorian artist painted 'Monarch of the Glen' and modelled the bronze lions at Nelson's Column.

clue.text: Fashionable, during tea, to produce porcelain

indicators.note: during means within the time of, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: cha (or char) is British slang for tea
in means fashionable, as in 'the in thing'

explanation.surface: Smart people at tea time bring out the best porcelain.
explanation.definitionFit: Fine porcelain is called after the country where it was first made.

clue.text: Disingenuous characters, nicer in south-east

indicators.note: characters as letters to be rearranged: the letters of nicer in, with those for south-east

parts.note: SE is the compass abbreviation for south-east

explanation.surface: Two-faced types are kinder down in the south-east.
explanation.walkthrough: 'characters' looks like people but means letters, rearranged with SE.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone not candid, pretending to be honest, is hypocritical and lacking sincerity.

clue.text: Black one's in fashion to discard

parts.note: jet is a deep black

indicators.note: in places the words for one's inside the word for fashion

parts.note: ton (French) means fashion or style
one's read as 'one is': I, the Roman numeral, followed by is

explanation.surface: Throw out the black item that is in vogue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one's' is read as 'I's', the numeral I plus S.
explanation.definitionFit: To throw goods overboard, or get rid of anything, is to jettison it.

clue.text: Lofty retreat for one in the old court

indicators.note: in places the letter for one inside the word for the old court

parts.note: an eyre was a medieval English circuit court held by travelling justices
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A high hideaway for a defendant in a historic court.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'justices in eyre' were judges who travelled round England holding court in the Middle Ages.
explanation.definitionFit: An eagle's nest is built high on a crag, and the word is used figuratively for any lofty dwelling.

clue.text: Furthest away, and without change for meter

parts.note: ex (Latin) means without, as in ex dividend

indicators.note: change for means alter the letters of meter, an anagram

explanation.surface: Remote, and lacking coins for the parking meter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without change for meter' suggests no coins, but 'change for' rearranges METER into TREME.
explanation.definitionFit: Something at the outermost point is extreme, the most remote.

clue.text: Northern cricket side with feeling for the absurd

parts.note: the on side is the leg side of a cricket field
sense as in a feeling or perception

explanation.surface: A cricket team from the north with an instinct for silliness.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the field is split into the off side and the on (or leg) side of the batter.
explanation.definitionFit: Rubbish talk or folly is what absurdity amounts to.

clue.text: Pauline may describe this message

parts.note: Pauline looks like a girl's name but means 'of St Paul', whose New Testament letters are known by that adjective

explanation.surface: A girl called Pauline might report this note.
explanation.definitionFit: A letter in the New Testament, such as Romans, is an epistle, and many are by St Paul.

clue.text: Spoke like Brutus, not qualifying for VAT?

definitions.meaning: Brutus made a public speech to the Romans after Caesar's death
zero-rated goods attract no value added tax

explanation.surface: The Roman conspirator's speech was exempt from tax.
explanation.walkthrough: VAT is Britain's value added tax; zero-rated items carry none, and O is zero.
explanation.definitionFit: Delivering a formal speech is speaking like an orator, and 'O-rated' is a pun on zero-rated.

clue.text: Old historian understood by you and me

parts.note: tacit means understood without being stated
us is the pronoun for you and me together

explanation.surface: An ancient chronicler whom we both grasp.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roman writer of the Annals and Histories chronicled the early empire.

clue.text: Murphy's pile

parts.note: murphy is slang for a potato, and a pile of potatoes stored under earth and straw has a special name

explanation.definitionFit: A heap of root vegetables covered with straw and soil for winter storage is a potato clamp.

clue.text: Lily no such long-legged toiler? (M. N. Dream)

definitions.text: Lily no such long-legged toiler? (M. N. Dream)

parts.words: Lily no such long-legged toiler? (M. N. Dream)
parts.note: Christ said lilies 'toil not, neither do they spin', so the lily is no one who spins

explanation.surface: A lily is no long-legged worker, as a line from Shakespeare's fairy play hints.
explanation.walkthrough: Two quotations combine: the Sermon on the Mount's lilies that neither toil nor spin, and the fairies' lullaby against spiders in A Midsummer Night's Dream. The scan prints 'long-legg'd', as in Shakespeare.
explanation.definitionFit: A spider weaving a web spins, and Shakespeare calls spiders long-legged ones in the fairies' song.

clue.text: Part-proprietorship yielding a growing turnover for farmers

definitions.meaning: a portion of ownership in a company
the blade of a plough turns over the soil in which crops grow

explanation.surface: Joint ownership that brings farmers an increasing income.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turnover' looks like money but is the soil the ploughshare turns.
explanation.definitionFit: A stake in a company is a portion of it, and the ploughshare is the blade that turns the furrow.

clue.text: Communiqué about leave for foreign affairs experts

indicators.note: about means around, so the word for communiqué goes round the word for leave

parts.note: a communiqué is an official statement
depart means leave

explanation.surface: An official notice about holiday entitlement for diplomats.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' looks like 'concerning' but means the first word wraps round the second.
explanation.definitionFit: The US government department handling foreign policy is staffed by experts on relations with other nations.

clue.text: Rejected writer cut connection

indicators.note: rejected means turned back, so the word for writer is read the other way round

parts.note: a pen is a writing instrument
hew means cut, as with an axe

explanation.surface: A turned-down author severs ties.
explanation.definitionFit: A brother's or sister's son is a family relation, connection in its old sense of a relative.

clue.text: Minister's title for Verne novel, in Russian

indicators.note: in places the rearranged author's name inside the word for Russian

parts.note: red was a common shorthand for a Russian communist

indicators.note: novel as an adjective means new, so the letters of Verne take a new form

explanation.surface: How a clergyman should be addressed in a Jules Verne story, translated into Russian.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' looks like a book by Jules Verne but is the anagram signal; 'Russian' is the old shorthand for a communist, split round the rearranged name.
explanation.definitionFit: A clergyman is styled 'the Reverend' before his name.
